item.title: Lake Winnebago harvest climbs to 1,371 sturgeon; 62 adult females from trigger
item.description: (WFRV) – The Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources released updated sturgeon spearing totals, showing continued harvest activity on Lake Winnebago as the Upriver season remains closed. On Lake Winnebago, 111 lake sturgeon were harvested, including 26 juvenile females, 43 adult females and 42 males.
